visualCharacteristics: Horizontal row of tab buttons (e.g. Overview, Itinerary, What to Bring) above a content panel. The selected tab is highlighted; switching tabs swaps the visible panel content.
contentPattern: One row per tab. First cell is the tab label; the rest of the row is that tab's panel content (paragraphs, images, links).
usage: Detail pages that split body content into switchable tabbed sections.
